Installation view · Hauptraum

Solveig Tarkamp  ·  Solo Exhibition

Halbinsel
Peninsula

A new body of fourteen works in polished basalt, raw salt, and projected light. Tarkamp's first solo presentation at Beton Galerie, developed over an eighteen-month research period on the Varanger Peninsula and at the Niederfinow basalt quarry in Brandenburg.

Project Room
Currently on view · Project Room

Ade Okonkwo — The Quiet Frequencies

A four-channel video installation accompanied by a printed score, made in collaboration with the radio archivist Mariko Hosoda. Documents the artist's six-week residency at Funkhaus Nalepastraße.

8 May–12 July 2026

Upcoming

Inés Berruga — Mariposas, después

Berruga's second solo at the gallery. New paintings on raw linen, made between Madrid and the artist's studio in Wedding. Curated by Karim Behzadi.

12 September–22 November 2026  ·  Vernissage 11 September · 19:00
